literal_glyph_notes: The clear printed E in EGAGF is outside the coordinate alphabet. Its single slot is retained as a source mask; it is not replaced to complete the opening label 18?. The 10 kW, 220 Volt, QOF and TAFUNK labels are preserved. The published Nov1–3 key decrypts this physical source, while the 31 October heading and 2 November reception date remain separate facts. No historical rekeying sequence is inferred.

All 286 received positions are observed ADFGVX coordinates and the complete 143-position plaintext re-encrypts exactly with no change. A high-resolution crop confirms the G in FVGVA; an initial low-resolution ambiguity is not treated as a source erasure.

The two five-dash groups occupy ten explicit source slots. The proposal fills six of them and changes two observed coordinates. Four plaintext positions remain unknown: one in the unit, one in Q?, and two in N?GQBECSER?K. TITELC remains literal, including its final C. The source omits the interception day; the plaintext date-like labels do not supply it.

The first source group is AXVFF; ALTES is already present in the complete raw reading. The later group VFFGF contains a clear F, not an out-of-alphabet T; neither visual correction is a historical ciphertext edit. The proposal changes one observed coordinate and fills three printed masks. The fourth mask leaves OS? unresolved. NICT is retained without adding H. Only the first of two announced parts is included.
